content: All concrete Hermes A2A multi-agent system implementations must include 7 mandatory core components to be complete and runnable: room-to-skill mapping, Letta + Hermes profile agent allocation per room, distillation pipeline (session_search → extract → pending queue → approved → agent memory), approval workflow, skill-to-agent sync, master orchestrator agent, and cron automation, with explicit file paths, data models, and runnable scripts provided for each.
